title: One pub a day closed permanently in England and Wales in 2025
summary: Data shows 366 were demolished or converted for other uses as cost pressures took toll on sector One pub a day disappeared for good in England and Wales during 2025 as sustained cost pressures continued to weigh heavily on the sector. Analysis of government statistics shows that 366 pubs were demolished or converted for other uses over the year to December. Continue reading...

title: Copper Set for Biggest Annual Gain Since 2009 on Supply Bets
